scripts.build: npm --workspace @wedding/contracts run build && npm --workspace @wedding/api run build && npm --workspace @wedding/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @wedding/contracts run typecheck && npm --workspace @wedding/api run typecheck && npm --workspace @wedding/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace @wedding/contracts run test && npm --workspace @wedding/api run test && npm --workspace @wedding/web run test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:contracts" "npm --workspace @wedding/api run dev" "npm --workspace @wedding/web run dev"
